text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold A and D for gains, then bought them back; before trimming, I should ask whether the sale fits my target allocation and whether I have a clear reason to re-enter.","My average cost can make a gain feel like a reason to sell or a loss feel like a reason to hold; I should assess each position by its current risk and role in the portfolio instead.","I made many purchases across several periods, so I should check cash needs and portfolio concentration before trading rather than letting frequent decisions crowd out a deliberate plan."]}
